name: Bora Bora
tagline: Overwater bungalows on the bluest lagoon
summary: Bora Bora is the dream South Pacific island: a jagged volcanic peak rising from a turquoise lagoon ringed by motu islets. Stay in an overwater bungalow, snorkel with rays and blacktip sharks, take a lagoon tour with a motu picnic and hike or 4x4 up for views.
seasonNote: May to October is dry and breezy; November to April is hot and rainy.
arrival: Fly from Tahiti (Papeete) in 50 minutes; resort boats meet you at the airport motu.
gettingAround: Resort boats and shuttles; bikes and scooters on the main island.
cashTip: Prices are shown in euros; locally you pay in CFP francs (XPF), pegged at about 119 XPF to 1 euro. Resorts take cards; carry some francs for snacks and boats.
foodTip: Poisson cru and Tahitian vanilla desserts.
buyTip: Tahitian black pearls and monoi oil.
baseArea: A motu resort or Matira Point
